newsitem.title: FINLAND: SILJA PLANS OPTIONS SCHEME FOR MANAGEMENT.
newsitem.headline: SILJA PLANS OPTIONS SCHEME FOR MANAGEMENT.

text.p: Finnish passenger ferry operator Silja Oy Ab said in a statement on Monday it would propose to the annual general meeting a 310,000 markka options scheme as an incentive for the company's management.
The warrants would entitle holders to subscribe up to 620,000 Silja A-shares at the weighted average price between April 10 and April 16, 1997 and adjusted for dividend, Silja said.
It said the interest-free bonds would mature after two years. Each 500 markka bond comes with 1,000 warrants, of which 300 are A warrants, 300 B warrants and 400 C warants.
Each warrant would entitle to subscribe one Silja A share with a nominal valieof 20 markka.

The first subscription period with A warrants would start April 1, 1998, the second with B warrants on April 1, 1999 and the third with C warrants on April 1, 2000. The subscription period ends on March 31, 2002.
